excerpts: When evaluating a model, metrics calculated against an entire test or validation set don't always give an accurate picture of how fair the model is. Great model performance overall for a majority of examples may mask poor performance on a minority subset of examples, which can result in biased model predictions. Using aggregate performance metrics such as precision , recall , and accuracy is not necessarily going to expose these issues.
